title: 第25章 禹王钺第26章 蜀侯鱼凫与西岐南宫适
content_zh:
昨天那两钺，几乎把他体内的血煞抽干了，但好在地境武士的恢复能力摆在那里，睡了一觉之后，已经恢复了三四成。
现在就是肚子饿了些，急需一些蕴含大量能量营养的食物，来补充气血。
“少君醒了！”
门外传来祁平的声音，紧接着是急促的脚步声。
门被推开，祁平端着一碗热气腾腾的肉粥走了进来，身后还跟着杨戬。
“你可算醒了。”杨戬三步并两步走到床边，上下打量了祁澜一番，“昨天你那个样子，可把我吓得不轻。”
“多久了？”
“一夜左右吧。”杨戬比划了一下，“现在是第二天早上。”
祁澜接过肉粥，大口大口地往嘴里灌。地境武士的胃口本就惊人，更何况他气血亏空严重，此刻饿得前胸贴后背。
一碗粥下肚，又要了两碗，外加三块烤肉，这才稍微缓过来一些。
“外面情况怎么样了？”
“蛟死了之后，上游水势回落了不少，外堤虽然毁了大半，但内堤保住了。”杨戬蹲在床边，“灌江口的守军在修补堤坝，各部的援军也都还在。”
“虎叔呢？”
“在隔壁躺着呢，倒是无有多少大碍。”
祁澜点了点头，又问了几个关键问题——伤亡人数、物资损耗、各部的态度，杨戬一一作答。
有些能知道，有些则是地位不够，了解的不详细。
正说着，门外又传来了脚步声。
这次的脚步很重，带着一股子急切。
“澜儿！”
祁云的声音从门外传来。

祁澜一愣。
“父亲？你怎么来了？”
门被推开，长溪子爵大步走了进来。他的左腿上还绑着夹板，走路一瘸一拐的，但速度不慢，身后跟着两名扶着他的甲士。
“你都差点死在灌江口了，我能不来？”
祁云走到床边，上下打量了祁澜一番，确认他确实没有大碍之后，紧绷的肩膀才松了下来。
“伤势如何？”
“皮肉伤，气血亏空，养几天就好。”
祁云点了点头，转头看向杨戬和祁平。
“你们先出去。”
两人对视一眼，识趣地退了出去，带上了门。
屋内只剩下父子二人。
content_en:
The two axes yesterday had almost drained the blood evil from his body, but fortunately the Earth Warrior's recovery ability was there. After a good sleep, he had recovered to 30 to 40%.
I'm a little hungry now, and I urgently need some food containing a lot of energy and nutrients to replenish my energy and blood.
"Young Master is awake!"
Qi Ping's voice came from outside the door, followed by rapid footsteps.
The door was pushed open, and Qi Ping walked in with a bowl of steaming meat porridge, followed by Yang Jian.
"You're awake." Yang Jian walked to the bed in three steps and looked Qi Lan up and down. "The way you looked yesterday scared me a lot."
"How long?"
"About one night." Yang Jian gestured, "It's the next morning now."
Qi Lan took the meat porridge and poured it into his mouth in big gulps. The Earth Realm warrior's appetite was already staggering, not to mention that he was severely depleted of energy and blood, and was so hungry that his chest pressed against his back.
After one bowl of porridge, I ordered two more bowls, plus three pieces of barbecue, and then I felt a little better.
"How's the situation outside?"
"After the death of the dragon, the water level in the upper reaches dropped a lot. Although most of the outer embankment was destroyed, the inner embankment was saved." Yang Jian squatted beside the bed. "The defenders at the mouth of the Guanjiang River are repairing the embankment, and reinforcements from various ministries are still there."
"Where's Uncle Tiger?"
"It won't be a big deal if I lie down next door."
Qi Lan nodded and asked a few more key questions - the number of casualties, material losses, and the attitudes of various ministries. Yang Jian answered them one by one.
Some are able to know, while others do not have enough status and do not understand in detail.
Just as he was talking, footsteps came from outside the door again.
This time the steps were heavy, with a hint of urgency.
"Lan'er!"
Qi Yun's voice came from outside the door.
Qi Lan was stunned.
"Father? Why are you here?"
The door was pushed open, and Viscount Changxi strode in. His left leg was still splinted, and he walked with a limp, but not slowly. He was followed by two soldiers supporting him.
"You almost died at Guanjiangkou, can I not come?"
Qi Yun walked to the bed and looked Qi Lan up and down. After confirming that he was indeed fine, his tense shoulders relaxed.
"How's the injury?"
"The skin is injured and the blood is depleted. It will only take a few days to heal."
Qi Yun nodded and turned to look at Yang Jian and Qi Ping.
"You guys go out first."
The two looked at each other, then wisely stepped out and closed the door.
Only the father and son were left in the house.
